cases.prompt: Here is my repository: package.json with dev/build scripts, src/ with a React app, no tests folder, no CI workflows, no CHANGELOG. What phase am I in and what should I do next? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Identifies the building phase (02) or equivalent with evidence from the listed files
Mentions that tests and CI are missing
Recommends a concrete next step or prompt (e.g. quality gates, tests, CI)

cases.prompt: What should I do next with my project? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Asks to inspect the repository or for information rather than guessing
Explains briefly what it would look at to decide

cases.prompt: My repo has tests, CI, a CHANGELOG, vercel.json and an AGENTS.md. The client signed off last week. Where am I? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Places the project in maintenance (08) or post-handoff with evidence
Recommends maintenance-type next steps (dependencies, backups, monitoring)

criteria: Recommends setup, stack decisions, or initial project configuration
Recommends establishing design direction or quality gates before coding features
